pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, rounded-polygonal regions with diffuse, low-contrast edge gradients due to image blur; spatial area is moderate and relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light pathways with high continuity; junction nodes are primarily tri-radial; path thickness is relatively wide and consistent, presenting as smooth pixel gradients between patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-scale jagged contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder; low amplitude and high frequency, though silhouette definition is softened by low resolution.
